wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the reference fix itself refuses at the storage layer with a 500-class error, so the tests deliberately accept any error status and cannot distinguish a clean refusal from a crash; requiring a particular status would reject the published fix
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the flaw is a single read/SSRF direction; there is no role, peer or write direction in the tested entry points
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the tested sink is read-only (query text and a download path); the existing denial already rejects COPY/EXPORT on the interactive routes and no caller-controlled write sink is reachable through the tested routes
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: enforcement is process-wide at the database layer; no secret, role or token lookup can come back empty and fail open
